title: Mastery challenge: prepare panel badges

checklist.step: Preserve each panel after setup and input changes
Draw prefixes actually returned by distinct callbacks

hints: What information distinguishes the panels after setup has returned?
Ask whether the saved functions all read one binding that the loop keeps changing.
A separate small factory call can give each saved function its own prefix binding.

questions.prompt: What must remain true when readings arrive later?

choices.why: The callbacks must also work after setup returns.
Each panel must preserve its own original prefix.
The callback interface supplies only a reading.

questions.prompt: What does callback position i preserve?

choices.why: That would confuse panels after configuration finishes.
Later list changes must not alter prepared behavior.
Position i must continue to return its original prefix.

questions.prompt: For n panels, what setup and later-call costs fit this solution?

choices.text: Linear setup, constant work per call
choices.why: One small callable per panel; each invocation constructs one pair, excluding drawing and using the bounded-value model.

choices.text: Constant setup, linear work per call
choices.why: The output already needs n callable positions.

choices.text: Linear setup, linear work per call
choices.why: A panel callback need not scan all other panels.

questions.prompt: What goes wrong when two callbacks read one loop binding over prefixes 4 and 9?

choices.why: After the loop the shared binding holds 9, so the first panel loses its 4.
The loop does not stop after assigning its first value.
Defining a function does not run its body.
